# IPv6 Destination Options (`ipv6_dstopts`)

- **Layer**: L3 (network)
- **Header**: variable length

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `next_header` | `uint(8)` | `253` | Protocol number of the next layer (see Next layer) | Protocol number of the header following this extension header (Auto). |
| `hdr_ext_len` | `uint(8)` |   | Length of the header in 64-bit words (`-1`) | Length of this extension header in 8-octet units, not counting the first 8 octets (Auto). |
| `options` | `bytes` — `hdr_ext_len * 8 + 6` octets | `01 04 00 00 00 00` |   | Raw TLV options, padded to a multiple of 8 bytes. |
| `padding` | `padding(8)` |   |   | Zero padding (Pad1) of the extension header to a multiple of 8 octets (Auto). |

## Next layer

The next layer is selected by `next_header`; when the field is Auto the builder writes the value of the protocol stacked above.

| Value | Protocol | Note |
|---|---|---|
| 0 (0x00) | [`ipv6_hopopts`](ipv6_hopopts.md) |   |
| 4 (0x04) | [`ipv4`](ipv4.md) |   |
| 6 (0x06) | [`tcp`](tcp.md) |   |
| 17 (0x11) | [`udp`](udp.md) |   |
| 41 (0x29) | [`ipv6`](ipv6.md) |   |
| 43 (0x2b) | [`ipv6_route`](ipv6_route.md) |   |
| 44 (0x2c) | [`ipv6_frag`](ipv6_frag.md) |   |
| 46 (0x2e) | [`rsvp`](rsvp.md) |   |
| 47 (0x2f) | [`gre`](gre.md) |   |
| 58 (0x3a) | [`icmpv6`](icmpv6.md) |   |
| 60 (0x3c) | [`ipv6_dstopts`](ipv6_dstopts.md) |   |
| 88 (0x58) | [`eigrp`](eigrp.md) |   |
| 89 (0x59) | [`ospfv3`](ospfv3.md) |   |
| 112 (0x70) | [`vrrpv3_ipv6`](vrrpv3_ipv6.md) |   |
| 115 (0x73) | [`l2tpv3`](l2tpv3.md) |   |
| 132 (0x84) | [`sctp`](sctp.md) |   |
| 143 (0x8f) | [`ethernet2`](ethernet2.md) |   |
